name: Sales operations performance
initial_prompt: Create an executive sales performance report covering revenue by region, product mix, target attainment, and discount discipline. Use the PDF context as business guidance.
refinement_prompts: Make the conclusion more action oriented and highlight which region should get management attention first.
Prefer charts that compare regions and products instead of showing raw rows.

name: HR retention risk
initial_prompt: Analyze employee retention risk by department, connecting attrition, engagement, tenure, manager score, and hiring pressure. Recommend where HR should act first.
refinement_prompts: Emphasize early-tenure attrition and explain the operational cost of open roles.
Keep the tone suitable for an executive people review.

name: Logistics quality and cost
initial_prompt: Build a logistics performance report that compares cost, late delivery rate, damage rate, and incident concentration by warehouse and carrier.
refinement_prompts: Call out the warehouse-carrier pair that needs immediate operational review.
Make sure cost is not interpreted without service quality context.

name: Education outcomes and investment
initial_prompt: Create an academic outcomes report comparing completion, placement, satisfaction, and investment by campus and program. Identify where budget appears most effective.
refinement_prompts: Use the second page for deeper interpretation of campus differences.
Make the final recommendation explicit for the provost.
